C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 276
Date 7/6/16
Shanghai Municipal Council.
June 8th 1916.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE JUNCTA IN UNO）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

Sir,

The troops at the Arsenal and Woosung have not yet
been paid, but there is no discontent among them.
It is reported that General Yang is arranging to borrow
sufficient money to pay them from the Nantao Chamber
of Commerce.

The Ming Ko Pao 民囯報 has, with to-day's issue
presented their readers with a pamphlet in which Sun Yat Sen's
declaration is printed in English and Chinese.

The declaration has already appeared in the
English newspapers.

Your Obedient Servant,
[Signature]
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

Entered on card June 1

刑事调查处
情报官登记
第 276 号
日期 1916年6月7日

上海工部局。
1916年6月8日。

（印章：上海工部局警务处 合众为一）

警务处，
（侦探科）

先生：

兵工厂和吴淞的部队尚未领到军饷，但士兵中并无不满情绪。
据报，杨将军正安排向南市商会借取足够款项以发放军饷。

《民国报》在今日发行的报纸中，向读者附赠了一本小册子，其中印有孙中山宣言的中英文版本。

该宣言已刊登于各英文报纸。

您忠实的仆人，
[签名]
总探长

警务处总监

6月1日录入卡片
